lessons.title: Foundations of Inferential Statistics & NHST
lessons.description: Navigate sample statistics vs. population parameters, Null (H0) and Alternative (H1) hypotheses, and what p-values really mean.

lessons.title: Decision Errors, Effect Size & Statistical Power
lessons.description: Master Type I vs. Type II errors, statistical power (1 - Beta), Cohen's d effect sizes, and why sample size is vital.

lessons.title: The Replication Crisis & Questionable Research Practices
lessons.description: Examine the Reproducibility Project, p-hacking, data peeking, HARKing, and the file-drawer publication bias.

lessons.title: The Open Science Reform & Rigorous Research Frontiers
lessons.description: Embrace modern scientific transparency: study preregistration, Registered Reports, open data, and direct replications.
